positions.as_written: Read a posterior drawer at 90 degrees as a test of this bundle and the posterior drawer near extension as a test of the capsule and corners.
Where a graft reproduces only this bundle, expect restraint to be restored in flexion and less well near extension.
Protect the articular margin of the medial condyle when working at the anterior edge of the footprint.
Treat the bundle as the flexion restraint and the posteromedial bundle with the capsule as the extension restraint.
Identify the cartilage margin before the footprint when working on the medial wall.
Consider the flexion angle at which restraint is most needed when planning which part of the footprint to reproduce.
Where the anterior meniscofemoral ligament is intact, preserve it.
Expect a single bundle graft to behave like this bundle, which means well in flexion and less well near extension.
